peas_matrix.performance_measure: Cost within ceiling, minimal layovers/stops, convenient departure time, airline reliability rating >= 4.0
peas_matrix.environment: Airline inventories, multi-tier pricing APIs (Amadeus, private data service, mock), flight schedules, seat classes
peas_matrix.actuators: API queries, flight option ranking, proposal submission to message bus, floor-price flag emission
peas_matrix.sensors: Trip request (origin, destination, departure date), category budget ceiling, HTTP response codes, latency metrics

peas_matrix.performance_measure: Nightly rate <= ceiling, guest review score >= 4.0/5.0, proximity to attractions, cancellation flexibility
peas_matrix.environment: Hotel booking systems, room inventory, location coordinates, seasonal demand curves
peas_matrix.actuators: Hotel search execution, room selection, cost-per-night calculation, reservation proposal generation
peas_matrix.sensors: Destination city, check-in/out dates, guest count, accommodation budget ceiling

peas_matrix.performance_measure: Activity bundle cost <= ceiling, diversity of cultural/leisure experiences, interest match score, schedule feasibility
peas_matrix.environment: Landmark registries, monument entry fees (ASI fees, museum tickets), operating hours, weather forecasts
peas_matrix.actuators: Itinerary curation, entry fee summation, activity pruning under budget pressure, day-by-day scheduling
peas_matrix.sensors: Traveler interests, trip duration, destination city, activity budget ceiling, weather conditions

peas_matrix.performance_measure: Total itinerary cost <= user budget, minimal negotiation rounds, fair category allocation, variance minimization
peas_matrix.environment: Multi-agent message log, accumulated proposals, user financial ceiling, category ceilings
peas_matrix.actuators: Budget variance evaluation, reallocation target flagging, ceiling adjustment signals, consensus authorization
peas_matrix.sensors: Submitted proposals from Flight/Hotel/Activity agents, user max budget, negotiation round counter

peas_matrix.performance_measure: Goal preservation rate under environmental shocks, replanning latency (< 200ms), plan stability
peas_matrix.environment: Dynamic external world: airline fare surges, hotel sold-out events, weather disruptions
peas_matrix.actuators: Belief revision, desire reconsideration, intention reconstruction, revised booking commitment
peas_matrix.sensors: Real-time pricing feeds, cancellation alerts, weather warnings, user goal constraints

peas_matrix.performance_measure: Zero packet corruption, sub-millisecond serialization latency, successful handshake and mutual commit
peas_matrix.environment: TCP/IP local/distributed network, stream sockets, JSON-serialized protocol frames
peas_matrix.actuators: Socket bind/connect, length-delimited JSON frame transmission, acknowledgment dispatch, connection teardown
peas_matrix.sensors: Socket buffer bytes, EOF signals, network latency timer, connection reset triggers

peas_matrix.performance_measure: 100% detection of unauthorized or modified messages, 0 false acceptances, cryptographic overhead < 5ms
peas_matrix.environment: Inter-agent communication channel, potential hostile interceptors, untrusted endpoints
peas_matrix.actuators: HMAC-SHA256 signature computation, sender identity validation, message quarantine/rejection, security audit logging
peas_matrix.sensors: Inbound payload bytes, cryptographic signatures, shared secret keys, nonce registry, timestamps

peas_matrix.performance_measure: Zero race conditions, sub-millisecond lock wait times, continuous throughput under heavy loads
peas_matrix.environment: Multi-threaded Python execution runtime, job queues, shared metric memory buffers
peas_matrix.actuators: Worker thread dispatch, queue push/pop, mutex lock acquisition/release, latency histogram updates
peas_matrix.sensors: Queue depth counter, task completion ticks, CPU execution time, thread liveness flags

environment_classifications.justification: Agents do not have full global knowledge of all airline seats, dynamic hotel rates, or future weather. They must probe external APIs and infer state through selective queries.
Prices, availability, weather, and third-party API response times fluctuate probabilistically. Actions (e.g. attempting to book at a price) have non-deterministic outcomes over time.
The environment evolves while agents deliberate: flight fares surge during high demand, hotel rooms sell out, and weather alerts arrive asynchronously.
Agents negotiate in discrete proposal rounds and communicate via discrete messages, but monetary budgets, latencies, and utility scores are continuous real numbers.
Agents share the overarching cooperative goal of constructing an optimal feasible trip, yet compete for finite budget allocations from the global expenditure pool.
Current decisions (e.g., flight chosen) directly constrain subsequent choices (e.g., hotel check-in time and remaining budget available for activities).

agent_vs_oop.autonomous_agent: Active: Retains internal control over whether and when to act. Evaluates percepts against goals before accepting or rejecting a proposal.
agent_vs_oop.oop_object: Passive: Encapsulates state, but delegates execution control to the caller. When a method is called, it executes blindly without self-determination.

agent_vs_oop.autonomous_agent: Goal-driven and proactive: Takes initiative to optimize utility, monitor background prices, and trigger replanning when environmental beliefs change.
agent_vs_oop.oop_object: Purely reactive: Only executes code when invoked directly by an external thread or method caller.

agent_vs_oop.autonomous_agent: Flexible communication: Negotiates over shared communication channels (ACL, JSON sockets, LangGraph message logs) with bidding, counter-proposals, and consensus.
agent_vs_oop.oop_object: Rigid method invocation: Caller must know exact method signatures, argument types, and return values; tight temporal and semantic coupling.

agent_vs_oop.autonomous_agent: Situated in a dynamic environment: Continuously updates internal beliefs via sensory feeds (weather, pricing) and actuates changes.
agent_vs_oop.oop_object: Self-contained internal state: Typically unaware of external environment unless passed as explicit parameters to method calls.

agent_vs_oop.autonomous_agent: Adaptive Replanning (BDI): Detects failure (e.g. over-budget, sold out) and autonomously searches for alternative recovery paths.
agent_vs_oop.oop_object: Exception bubbling: Raises exceptions up the call stack; relies on caller to catch or crashes execution flow.

agent_vs_oop.autonomous_agent: Utility maximization under uncertainty and resource constraints.
agent_vs_oop.oop_object: Data abstraction, encapsulation, and code reuse through modular interfaces.

Option B selected: Re-routing to SpiceJet SG-812 (1-stop, 1h layover) at ₹11,800 + adjusting hotel room to Executive Standard at ₹15,200.
Intentions revised: Revoked I1 (IndiGo surged), committed I1-ALT (SpiceJet) and I2-ADJ.
